betterquesting:10.desc:8:
Most NTM tools have §6abilities§r listed in their tooltip. §eRight click§r cycles through them, §eShift + right click§r goes back to the first one, and §eLeft Alt§r opens a menu where you can build your own presets. One area ability and one harvest ability can be active at the same time; better tools unlock higher levels.

§lArea abilities§r
- §6Vein Miner§r - mines the whole connected vein of the same block.
- §6AoE§r - mines a cube around the block, radius 1 to 4.
- §6Flat AoE§r - the same, but only in the plane you are facing. Good for tunnels.
- §6Explosion§r - blows up the block you hit instead of mining it.

§lHarvest abilities§r
- §6Silk Touch§r and §6Fortune§r work like the enchantments, Fortune goes up to level 9.
- §6Auto-Smelter§r drops the furnace result of the block.
- §6Auto-Shredder§r drops the Shredder result.
- §6Auto-Centrifuge§r drops the Centrifuge result.
- §6Auto-Crystallizer§r drops the Ore Acidizer result.
- §6Mercury Touch§r turns redstone ore and redstone blocks into §6Mercury Droplets§r.
